layers.name: grass
layers.from: MB4 grass (day) and target 07's lawn: golden-green big flat clumps in three values (a cool dark under-mass, the body, a lit spiky crown toward the light), overlapping like scales over three soft masses; olive, never lime (rule 4)

layers.name: leaves
layers.from: MB4 (the floor under the spruce, day); rule 9: leaf litter as a few leaf shapes

layers.name: dirt
layers.from: MB4 road (day): two or three value masses, warm; target 04's road, 05's track

layers.name: mud
layers.from: MB4 road (the ruts' wet earth, a step darker than the road)

layers.name: stone
layers.from: MB3 (the town's rough paving as chunky planes, warm tops, cool joints); the setts' own maps are wave 2

layers.name: rock
layers.from: MB4 rock: a few big rounded planes in muted moon-blue grey, moss on the top planes

layers.name: blight
layers.from: (c) the blight's burned ground, as ash masses and long dark cracks
